subject: Insurance
title: Health Wearables and Premiums
description: A quick win: understand Health Wearables and Premiums.

hook.text: John Hancock requires all life insurance customers to use a Fitbit or Apple Watch.

buildup.text: The Vitality program rewards healthy behavior: gym visits, step counts.

discovery.text: Active policyholders live longer and file fewer claims.

twist.text: Not everyone can exercise equally. Disabled or chronically ill people face higher premiums in a wellness-tracked world.

climax.text: Wearable insurance rewards health but risks penalizing illness. Incentive and discrimination share a blurry boundary.

punchline.text: Steps lower premiums. But what if you can't walk? The line blurs.

quiz.question: What controversial issue arises from wearable-based insurance?
options: People who can't exercise may face unfairly higher premiums
